description: New Zealand Grid 500 metre, 2023 is a dataset listed in Stats NZ Geographic Data Service (datafinder.stats.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by GIS. A square grid framework. This is one of three resolutions of grid, 1 kilometre, 500 metres and 250 metres, where the distance is the length of one side of the square grid cell. This is the 500 metre resolution grid. The extent of the grid encompasses the New Zealand 12-mile territorial limit. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher GIS. Its tags are 500 metres grid, 500m, Downloadable Data, grids. It offers 1 resource(s) in vector. The portal shows 2024-10-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-stats-portal.
